ref: ADR-0025 Data errors name their box (F-19, Q10): a malformed date is err:FORG0001 in both back ends, naming the box; ADR-0003: parsing is strict, so a day the month lacks is no date
note: sourceFormat yyyyMMdd: Sku in context Orders is 20260230, which has the digits of the pattern but no date: February 2026 has no day 30. The run raises err:FORG0001 at N1; a lenient parse would give 02.03.2026.
